questions.question: What is Machine Learning?
questions.ideal_answer: Machine Learning is a field of AI that enables systems to learn patterns from data and make predictions.

questions.question: Classification vs Regression?
questions.ideal_answer: Classification predicts categories while regression predicts numerical values.

questions.question: What is Training Data?
questions.ideal_answer: Training data is used to teach a model patterns and relationships.

questions.question: What is Testing Data?
questions.ideal_answer: Testing data evaluates model performance on unseen examples.

questions.question: What is Validation Data?
questions.ideal_answer: Validation data helps tune hyperparameters and select the best model.

questions.question: Explain Random Forest.
questions.ideal_answer: Random Forest combines multiple decision trees to improve accuracy and reduce overfitting.

questions.question: Explain Decision Trees.
questions.ideal_answer: Decision Trees split data into branches based on feature values to make predictions.

questions.question: What is Feature Engineering?
questions.ideal_answer: Feature engineering creates and transforms variables to improve model performance.

questions.question: What is Cross Validation?
questions.ideal_answer: Cross-validation evaluates models by splitting data into multiple folds.

questions.question: Explain Precision and Recall.
questions.ideal_answer: Precision measures prediction correctness while recall measures the ability to find actual positives.

questions.question: Explain XGBoost.
questions.ideal_answer: XGBoost is a high-performance gradient boosting algorithm known for accuracy and efficiency.

questions.question: How do you deploy ML models?
questions.ideal_answer: Deploy using FastAPI, Flask, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.

questions.question: What is Model Drift?
questions.ideal_answer: Model drift occurs when model performance decreases because real-world data changes.

questions.question: Feature Selection Techniques?
questions.ideal_answer: Methods include correlation analysis, Recursive Feature Elimination, Lasso, and tree-based importance.

questions.question: How do you monitor ML models in production?
questions.ideal_answer: Track accuracy, latency, drift, errors, resource usage, and retrain when needed.
